effective.basis: Old state: UDE official card rulings (Sangan/Witch: 'If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify', captured 2005-06-16) through Konami's own per-set rulings documents - Machina Mayhem (2010-04-06, 18 days before the Edison snapshot), Starstrike Blast (2010-11-16), Storm of Ragnarok (2011-02-02). New state: KDE-US Tournament Policy section 'Card/Hand/Deck Verification' forbids verifying the opponent's Deck (first located capture 2019-04-03; still current in v2.5, 2025-09-05). No dated announcement of the change was found, so the interval 2011-02-02 .. 2019-04-03 stays open.

changes.historical_text: Your opponent selects 1 Insect-Type Monster from their Deck. After shuffling the Deck, place the card on top of the Deck.
changes.summary: Period procedure only: the sole difference between goat/c504700168.lua and official/c95214051.lua is `else Duel.GoatConfirm(1-tp,LOCATION_DECK)`. This card makes the OPPONENT search their own Deck for an Insect-Type monster, so the reveal runs against the opponent's Deck (`1-tp`) - if they hold no Insect they show their Deck to prove it, which the modern script never does. Both scripts' `s.target` checks only that the opponent's Deck is non-empty, so there is no activation-condition difference; this is the verification procedure alone, hence the shared chronology applies cleanly.

review.notes: Both full scripts read; identical apart from the added else-branch. The lineage has only two English versions and the modern cdb text is byte-identical to lineage v1, which the goat variant also matches exactly - so across the recorded chain there is literally no text difference at all, only the era procedure (modern_text_version null). v0 (IOC-100, 2004-03-01) -> v1 (DR2-EN101, 2005-10-20) is a pronoun change ("his/her" -> "their"). This is a rare inversion of the usual verification case: the deck being revealed is the opponent's, not the controller's.
